Class SecureXmlFactories

java.lang.Object
nl.b3p.brmo.loader.util.SecureXmlFactories
public final class SecureXmlFactories extends Object
Factories for XML processing which are hardened against XXE attacks using Apache Commons Secure XML, which resolves external references to empty content. On top of that the DocumentBuilderFactory and XMLInputFactory reject documents with a DOCTYPE, so a malicious document fails instead of being silently processed.

    • newTransformerFactory

      public static TransformerFactory newTransformerFactory() throws TransformerConfigurationException
      Create a TransformerFactory which resolves external entities, DTDs, stylesheets and documents to empty content and has secure processing enabled (entity expansion limits, no extension functions). Stylesheets loaded via a URIResolver set on the factory are still allowed.
      Returns:
      hardened transformer factory
      Throws:
      TransformerConfigurationException - if the implementation does not support secure processing
